source: She said that he had already sent them our address.
translation: 她说他已经把我们的地址发给他们了
englishMeaning: The female speaker reported that the male person had already sent the address belonging to our group to them.

source: They asked us to tell you that the meeting had been canceled.
translation: 他们让我们通知你，会议取消了
englishMeaning: A group of people requested that we inform the addressee that the meeting is no longer occurring.

source: He said you could send it to me directly.
translation: 他说你可以直接发给我
englishMeaning: He stated that you have the permission to send the object to me directly.

source: We haven't told her yet because we're waiting for your confirmation.
translation: 我们还没告诉她，在等您的确认
englishMeaning: We have not informed her because we are waiting for you to confirm the matter.

source: Nana asked David to help Sarah with her report.
translation: Nana 请 David 帮忙处理 Sarah 的报告
englishMeaning: Nana requested that David provide assistance to Sarah regarding Sarah's report.

source: May said she may join us later.
translation: May 说她待会儿可能会加入我们
englishMeaning: May stated that it is possible that she will join the group at a later time.

source: Will said he will send it tomorrow.
translation: Will 说他明天会发送
englishMeaning: Will stated that he will send the item tomorrow.

source: Will you ask May if she can join us?
translation: 你能帮忙问问 May 方便一起参加吗
englishMeaning: The speaker asks the recipient to inquire if May is available to join them.

source: I gave her your number, but I didn't give you hers.
translation: 我把你的电话号码给她了，但没把她的号码给你
englishMeaning: I provided your telephone number to her, but I did not provide her telephone number to you.

source: You told me to contact him, but he told me to contact you.
translation: 你之前让我联系他，但他让我来联系你
englishMeaning: The user states that I instructed them to contact a third party, and that third party in turn instructed the user to contact me.

source: Please ask him to remind her to reply to us.
translation: 请让他提醒她给我们回个信
englishMeaning: The speaker requests the intermediary to ask the man to remind the woman to send a reply to the speaker and their associates.

source: My manager asked your assistant to contact their driver.
translation: 我的经理让你助理联系一下他的司机
englishMeaning: My manager requested that your assistant get in touch with my manager's driver.

source: She filled out the form herself, but I submitted it for her.
translation: 表格是她自己填的，但我帮她提交了
englishMeaning: She completed the form by herself, but I performed the action of submitting it on her behalf.

source: The documents were sent to David by Sarah, not by me.
translation: 文件是 Sarah 发给 David 的，不是我发的
englishMeaning: The documents were sent by Sarah to David, and the speaker was not the one who sent them.

source: I didn't ask you to cancel the order; I asked you to hold off on payment.
translation: 我没有让你取消订单，我是让你先别付款
englishMeaning: The speaker informs the recipient that they did not request the cancellation of the order, but rather requested that the payment process be delayed.

source: You don't have to reply today, but please read it before tomorrow's meeting.
translation: 你今天不必回复，但请在明天的会议前阅读一下
englishMeaning: The recipient is not obligated to provide a reply today, but the recipient must read the material prior to the meeting scheduled for tomorrow.

source: Not everyone has received the update.
translation: 不是所有人都收到了更新
englishMeaning: It is not the case that every person has received the update.

source: None of them has approved the request.
translation: 他们还没人批准那个请求
englishMeaning: None of the individuals in the group has given approval for the request.

source: I only asked him to check the amount, not to approve the payment.
translation: 我只是让他核对一下金额，没让他审批付款
englishMeaning: I requested that he verify the payment amount, but I did not request that he authorize the payment itself.

source: She isn't refusing to help; she just needs more time.
translation: 她不是不肯帮忙，只是还需要一点时间
englishMeaning: The female person is not declining to provide assistance, she only requires an additional amount of time to complete the task.

source: Don't send the files until Nana confirms the address.
translation: 在Nana确认地址之前，先别发送文件
englishMeaning: The sender instructs that the files should not be sent until Nana provides confirmation of the address.

source: If he hasn't replied by noon, ask her to call him.
translation: 如果他中午还没回复，就让她们给他打个电话
englishMeaning: If the male subject has not provided a response before 12:00 PM, instruct the female subject to telephone the male subject.

source: Even if they agree, we still need your approval.
translation: 即使对方同意了，这件事仍然需要您的批准
englishMeaning: Even if the other party agrees, our team still requires your approval.

source: Unless you tell me otherwise, I'll use the latest version.
translation: 除非你告诉我其他方案，否则我就用最新版本了
englishMeaning: If you do not inform me of a change, I will use the most recent version.

source: By the time I called her, she had already spoken to you.
translation: 我给她打电话的时候，她已经和你谈过了
englishMeaning: When the speaker called the woman, the woman had already finished speaking to the recipient of this message.

source: He might send it today, but he hasn't promised.
translation: 他今天可能会发过来，但他没给准话
englishMeaning: The male subject might send the object today, but he has not made a promise to do so.

source: You don't owe me anything; I owe you NGN 25,000.
translation: 你不欠我什么，是我欠你 25,000 奈拉
englishMeaning: The listener does not have a debt to the speaker; the speaker has a debt of 25,000 NGN to the listener.

source: We paid them USD 1,250.50, but they refunded only USD 1,205.50.
translation: 我们付了他们1,250.50美元，但他们只退了1,205.50美元
englishMeaning: We transferred 1,250.50 USD to them, but they returned only 1,205.50 USD to us.

source: Each of the three employees should receive NGN 20,000, making NGN 60,000 in total.
translation: 三名员工每人应收到 20,000 奈拉，总计 60,000 奈拉
englishMeaning: Three employees are each to be given NGN 20,000, which results in a total sum of NGN 60,000.

source: David has twice as many orders as I do, but only half as many as Sarah.
translation: David的订单数是我的两倍，但只有Sarah的一半
englishMeaning: David has two times the number of orders as the speaker, and David has one half the number of orders as Sarah.

source: Could you give me a heads-up before you change the schedule?
translation: 你之后如果要改行程，能不能先跟我说一声
englishMeaning: The speaker is asking the listener to provide an advance notification to the speaker before the listener makes any changes to the schedule.

source: I'm not sure I follow. Are you saying we should wait?
translation: 我不太明白，你的意思是我们要等一下吗
englishMeaning: The speaker expresses a lack of understanding regarding the previous statement and asks if the recipient is advising that they should wait.

source: No rush—just send it over when you get a chance.
translation: 不急，你有空的时候发给我就行
englishMeaning: There is no urgency for the recipient to perform the action of sending the item; the recipient should send the item whenever they have availability.

source: Someone from support called me. They said they'd check it for us.
translation: 有个客服联系了我，说会帮我们查一下
englishMeaning: A person from the support department contacted the speaker and promised that the support person would verify the matter on behalf of the speaker and their team.

source: When David spoke to Michael, he sounded upset.
translation: David 和 Michael 说话时，听起来不太高兴
englishMeaning: When David was speaking to Michael, David expressed an upset tone.
